description: Write or grow prose block by block or scene by scene from an outline, bible, or raw material — fiction and nonfiction. Use when the spine, structure, or story engine is settled and actual prose is needed; when extending a draft paragraph by paragraph or scene by scene; when the user asks to draft, write the next chapter or section, or turn an outline into prose. Not for line polish (writing-edit) or diagnosis (writing-critique).
